Start your electric bike adventure:
We offer the top-tier design on the market.The Ultimate Retro Motorcycle-Style Fat Tire Electric Bike Experience Our ebike blends vintage charm with modern reliability. Front and rear dual shock absorbers ensure a smooth ride on any terrain, paired with durable 20"X4" puncture-resistant fat tires and dual disc brakes. Unmatched in style and functionality, it's a stunning blend of retro allure and cutting-edge performance.
All-Terrain & 330-Pound Capacity:
Conquer any terrain with 20"x4" All-Terrain Tires，our e-bike ensures robust grip and stability on snow, beaches, mountains, and city roads. Engineered with a dense center tread pattern, these tires prevent punctures from thorns and debris. With a weight capacity of 330 pounds, our electric bike are perfect for daily commuting and outdoor adventures.
Electric bike upgraded 250W brushless hub motor:
Electric bike equipped with a 250W high-speed brushless rear hub motor, this adult battery ebike provides impressive hill-climbing power and a top speed of 20mph (Affected by load, temperature, road conditions, etc.). The electric bike also comes with brighter LED headlights and taillights for improved visibility and safety when riding at night.
Electric bike are equipped with large-capacity batteries:
Our upgraded 15AH detachable battery (with key lock) powers your ride, delivering up to 22 miles per charge in electric-only mode and up to 35 miles in pedal-assist mode. Mileage may vary based on load, temperature, road conditions, and riding mode. The built-in Battery Management System (BMS) allows for a quick 7-8 hours charge at home or in the office.
3 Riding Modes & 7-Speed:
Electric bike, pedal-assist bike, and regular bike. With the intelligent display panel, you can choose the level of electric assistance according to your needs. Equipped with the Shimano7 variable speed system, our electric moped cycle bikes offer 7 different speeds.
Easy Installation & Customer Support:
With 90% pre-assembly, you can easily install it.The packaging includes all necessary tools and detailed instructions. Our team consists of a group of professional, enthusiastic and communicative guys, we would like to stay in touch with you if you have any troubles till your problems have been solved.
❤NOTE:
During usage, please ensure the use of the provided charger and follow the charging guidelines provided by the manufacturer. Avoid overcharging or leaving the bike to charge inhigh-temperature environments to ensure battery lifespan and safety.
